description: This PHP source file defines the HolidayDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project. The class decorates an instance of the Holiday entity, providing formatted date and length name retrieval functionalities, utilizing traits and constants defined elsewhere in the project.

classes.name: HolidayDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides formatted representations of properties of a Holiday entity, such as date and holiday length name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HolidayDecorator with a Holiday entity.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of the holiday.

methods.name: getLengthName
methods.description: Returns the descriptive name of the holiday's length, if available.
